question: Should the Measure tool read colors off the picture for the spec?
context: Figma and Sketch show an element color beside its size in inspect mode; Shottr and CleanShot X have no color readout. Photonz has color pickers for choosing ink but nothing that reads a color off the capture. The user has asked that speculative features be confirmed before they are built.

options.label: Add a Color mode to Measure
options.summary: Pick Measure, choose Color, and a swatch pill with the hex value follows the pointer. Click and it lands as a row beside your measurements and as a line in the spec list.
pros: A spec hand-off carries colors as well as sizes, which Figma and Sketch inspect already show
Same tool, same pill, same list: nothing new to find
Option-click averages a small area so anti-aliased text does not mislead
cons: A screenshot color is the rendered color, so shadows, blending and display profiles can shift it a little from the design token
One more mode in the Measure flyout
options.mitigation: The pill says the value is read from the picture, and the averaged sample keeps single stray pixels out of the spec.

options.label: Not now, ask again after the measure tools have been tried
options.summary: Nothing changes. The Measure tool stays about sizes, gaps and alignment until you have redlined a few real captures with it and know what is missing.
pros: No speculative work; the queue stays on the measure fixes already in hand
cons: Colors keep needing a separate tool during a hand-off
options.mitigation: The card can be reopened from the next manager pass once you have used Size and Gap on real work.
